content: As community finding is an ill-defined problem BIBREF31, we choose to treat CCM as a simple undirected, unweighted graph. We use the values learned in the CSM for $X_u$ and $Y_i$ for various values of $u$ and $i$, which approximate the matrix $P$. Similar to BIBREF29 hu2008collaborative, we can calculate the correlation between two rows (and hence two characters).
